responsibility: This header declares the dynamic-string command-line argument API for the mc-boot runtime. It exports procedures to retrieve argv entries as newly allocated DynamicStrings_String values and to query the argument count, providing the higher-level string interface parallel to the buffer-based Args module.
same_name_distinction: This .h file is the interface half of GSArgs: it declares the routines for retrieving command-line arguments as DynamicStrings and querying their count, while gcc/m2/mc-boot/GSArgs.cc performs the actual UnixArgs access and string wrapping.
